note: Embedded named presets a document reaches through `extends`. The set is deliberately small: a preset is a public compatibility surface, and every name shipped here is one that cannot be removed without a schema major. Layout sizing is absent on purpose — the geometry presets own the long side and the byte budget for each profile, and restating either here would create a second source of truth that drifts.

defaults.note: The weakest layer: what a document that says nothing at all resolves to. These are product choices, so they live in data rather than in Go. `card` is the default profile because the accepted site composition is many small card illustrations and one hero; `un` is the default boundary by DEC-002; `standalone` is the default delivery because an asset that needs no host CSS is the safer default for someone trying the tool for the first time; markers are off by REQ-7 and animation by REQ-8. Layout carries only a mode — the long side comes from the geometry preset for the resolved profile, and restating it here would fork the budget.

presets.name: site-default
presets.note: Carries only what it changes from the defaults. A preset that restates a default adds nothing and makes `explain` attribute the value to the preset instead of to where it actually comes from.

presets.name: standalone-default
presets.note: The same shape baked rather than themed: an asset that carries its own presentation and needs no host CSS.
